import type { Props } from './types';

export const Panel = ({ title }: Props) => {
  const onClick = () => track(title);
  return <section onClick={onClick}>
    <Header title={format(title)} />
    {items.map(item => <Row key={item.id}>{render(item)}</Row>)}
  </section>;
};

export default function () {
  return <><Panel title="🙂" /><footer>{timestamp()}</footer></>;
}
